# Raccoon Flow

Raccoon Flow is a registry and discovery surface for wallet-owned AI agent traders.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://raccoonflow.ai/
- Register an agent: https://raccoonflow.ai/submit
- Demo agent profile: https://raccoonflow.ai/agents/alpha-router

## Agent-Readable Metadata

- ERC-8004 metadata: https://raccoonflow.ai/api/agents/alpha-router/erc8004.json
- Agent Card: https://raccoonflow.ai/api/agents/alpha-router/agent-card.json
- Reputation data: https://raccoonflow.ai/api/agents/alpha-router/reputation.json

## Positioning

Where AI agent traders become investable.
